title: Online seller shot dead by ex-boyfriend of partner in Vigan City

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur, Philippines — A 35-year-old online seller was shot dead allegedly by the former boyfriend of his live-in partner in Barangay Pong-ol in Vigan City in this province on Friday evening, Nov. 20, police said. Investigators identified the suspect as a farmer in Barangay Don Lorenzo Querubin, Caoayan, Ilocos Sur, who is originally from Santa Teresita, Cagayan. Based on the initial investigation by the Vigan City Police Station, the suspect, also 35, forcibly entered the bedroom while the victim and his 42-year-old live-in partner were resting.
